procs.rm: Multiple crude grades (Indian + imported, sour/sweet, light/heavy, varying API gravity)
procs.ut: Power (pumps, mixers), heating (some heavy crudes), instrumentation
procs.out: Blended crude to CDU feed; stored crude inventory by grade
procs.q: Crude assay (API gravity, sulphur%, TAN, salt content, water%, distillation profile)

d: Analyses available crude grades (assays), refinery LP model, product slate target and crude economics.
Models crude blend compatibility (asphaltene stability), unit constraints and margin per crude.
Provides crude purchase + blending advisory for maximum margin without operational risk.
p: Compatibility models exist but not used systematically
LP model decisions vs operational reality
uc.calc: Crude margin optimization $0.05-0.15/bbl × 7 bbl/t × 1 MMTPA. ₹8 cr per MMTPA crude.

d: Analyses tank inventory levels, tank chemistry (sediment, water, BS&W), product movement patterns and tank maintenance history.
Detects sludge buildup, water bottoms, sampling discrepancies and tank capacity issues.
Provides inventory optimization and tank maintenance advisory.
p: Tank inventories don't match measured (sediment, water)
uc.calc: Inventory accuracy + sludge management. ₹2 cr per MMTPA crude.

procs.rm: Crude oil from storage (containing salt, water, sediment)
procs.ut: Power (mix valves, transformers), wash water, demulsifier chemicals
procs.out: Desalted crude to CDU preheat train
procs.q: Salt content (PTB - lb/1000 bbl), water content, sediment, oil-water emulsion stability

d: Analyses desalter performance (salt removal, water in oil, oil in water), wash water dosing and demulsifier addition.
Models electrostatic separation effectiveness and predicts salt content reaching CDU.
Provides chemical dosing + voltage advisory for target salt level.
p: High salt damages CDU overhead system (corrosion, fouling)
uc.calc: Corrosion prevention + chemical savings + CDU reliability. ₹3 cr per MMTPA crude.

procs.rm: Desalted crude oil
procs.out: LPG, naphtha, kero/ATF, diesel, AGO, atmospheric residue (long residue)
procs.q: Cut point control (initial/final BP), product distillation (D86 ASTM), specific gravity, flash point

d: Analyses CDU operating conditions (column temperatures, reflux, stripping steam), crude properties and product yields/specs.
Models distillation kinetics and predicts product yields versus operating conditions for each crude blend.
Provides cut-point and operating setpoint advisory for maximum high-value product yield.
p: Reflux often higher than needed (wasted energy)
uc.calc: Higher-value product yield uplift 0.5-1% × refining margin. ₹10 cr per MMTPA crude.

uc.t: Heat Exchanger Network Fouling Detection & Cleaning Advisory
d: Critical heat exchanger network in CDU/VDU preheat train (20+ exchangers).
Analyses heat duty, fouling factors and approach temperatures across HEN to detect individual exchanger fouling.
Models fouling progression and predicts cleaning intervention timing for maximum heat recovery.
p: HEN fouling silent — adds to heater duty
uc.calc: Heat recovery improvement 5-10°C preheat = 2-3% fuel reduction × heater fuel cost. ₹5 cr per MMTPA crude.

d: Analyses side stripper steam usage and product cut quality (95% point, flash point compliance).
Models stripping vs quality tradeoff.
Provides stripping steam advisory for spec compliance at minimum steam.
uc.calc: Steam reduction 10-20% × stripper steam cost. ₹3 cr per MMTPA crude.

procs.rm: Process fluid (crude or residue) for heating
procs.ut: Fuel gas / refinery fuel oil, combustion air, steam (atomization)
procs.out: Heated process fluid at target temperature
procs.q: Heater efficiency %, fuel consumption (kCal/kg), excess air %, tube skin temperatures, draft

d: Analyses heater performance (fuel firing, excess air, tube skin temperatures, draft, fouling).
Models heater combustion efficiency and predicts fuel consumption.
Provides combustion + draft + tube monitoring advisory for minimum fuel at target outlet temperature.
p: Heaters run with excess air (safety margin)
Fuel cost is biggest variable cost
Tube life shortened by uneven firing
uc.calc: Fuel reduction 3-5% × heater fuel cost. ₹6 cr per MMTPA crude.

procs.rm: Atmospheric residue (long residue from CDU bottom)
procs.ut: Fuel (heater), steam (stripping + ejectors), power, vacuum system
procs.out: Light/heavy vacuum gas oil (LVGO/HVGO), vacuum residue (short residue) to coker/FCC/HCU
procs.q: Vacuum level, cut points (LVGO/HVGO), Conradson Carbon Residue (CCR), heavy metals (Ni, V)

uc.t: VDU Vacuum & Heavy Cut Yield Optimization
d: Analyses vacuum column performance (vacuum level, ejector system, heater coil temperature, cut points).
Models VDU separation efficiency and predicts HVGO/VR cut.
Provides vacuum + temperature setpoint advisory for maximum HVGO recovery.
p: Heater coil temperature limited by coking risk
uc.calc: HVGO yield uplift × downstream margin + ejector steam optimization. ₹6 cr per MMTPA crude.

procs.rm: Straight-run diesel + light cycle oil (LCO) + light coker gas oil (LCGO)
procs.out: BS-VI compliant ultra-low sulfur diesel (sulfur <10 ppm)
procs.q: Sulfur content (target <10 ppm for BS-VI), cetane number, distillation, density, cold flow properties

d: Analyses reactor temperature profile, weighted average bed temperature (WABT), pressure drop, sulfur slip and feed quality.
Models catalyst deactivation kinetics and predicts remaining cycle life.
Provides operating advisory to extend cycle while maintaining BS-VI sulfur compliance.
p: Catalyst replacement expensive (₹20-50 cr per change) + multi-day downtime
Operating temperature crept up over cycle (more H2, less margin)
uc.calc: Cycle extension 6-12 months × catalyst cost + downtime avoidance. ₹10 cr per MMTPA crude.

uc.t: BS-VI Sulfur Compliance & H2 Consumption Optimization
d: Analyses real-time sulfur (online analyser), reactor conditions, feed sulfur and H2 partial pressure.
Models hydrodesulfurization (HDS) kinetics and predicts product sulfur.
Provides reactor temperature + H2 advisory for spec compliance at minimum H2 consumption.
p: BS-VI sulfur target (<10 ppm) is tight
kpi: Product sulfur compliance (<10 ppm for BS-VI)
uc.calc: H2 reduction 5-10% × H2 cost. ₹5 cr per MMTPA crude.

d: Analyses reactor bed temperature profile, quench gas distribution and exotherm patterns across multiple beds.
Detects channeling, bed maldistribution and hot/cold spots.
Provides quench gas distribution advisory for stable operation.
p: Bed maldistribution causes catalyst utilization loss
uc.calc: Catalyst utilization + bed life. ₹3 cr per MMTPA crude.

f: Treated naphtha. Sour gas to amine + SRU
procs.rm: Straight-run naphtha (SR naphtha) from CDU
procs.out: Hydrotreated naphtha (low sulfur) to reformer feed
procs.q: Sulfur content (target <0.5 ppm for reformer), nitrogen, RON, distillation

d: Analyses NHT performance (sulfur slip, naphtha quality) versus reformer requirements.
Models reformer poisoning risks (sulfur, nitrogen) and predicts reformer activity decline.
Provides NHT advisory for reformer protection.
p: Sulfur slip to reformer kills catalyst
uc.calc: Reformer catalyst protection + downtime avoidance. ₹3 cr per MMTPA crude.

f: Reformate. Catalyst flows through reactors and is continuously regenerated.
procs.rm: Hydrotreated naphtha (low sulfur) from NHT
procs.out: Reformate (high octane gasoline component), H2 (consumed elsewhere), LPG, fuel gas
procs.q: Reformate RON (typically 95-100), reformate yield %, H2 yield, catalyst activity

d: Analyses reactor inlet temperatures (WAIT), feed properties, octane number and reformate yield.
Models reforming kinetics and selectivity at varying severity.
Provides reactor WAIT + recycle ratio advisory for target octane at maximum yield.
p: Operating at high severity = more octane but lower yield + faster coking
uc.calc: Reformate yield uplift + octane optimization. ₹6 cr per MMTPA crude.

d: Analyses continuous catalyst regeneration (CCR) parameters: catalyst flow rate, regeneration zones (combustion, oxychlorination, drying, reduction).
Models catalyst aging and regeneration effectiveness.
Provides regeneration setpoint advisory for catalyst activity restoration.
uc.calc: Catalyst activity maintenance + cycle stability. ₹3 cr per MMTPA crude.

d: Analyses reformer H2 generation versus refinery H2 demand and operating conditions.
Models H2 generation kinetics.
Provides operating advisory for maximum H2 yield at acceptable octane.
p: Reformer H2 is byproduct of octane making
H2 demand varies with diesel hydrotreating load
H2 makeup from SMR is expensive
uc.calc: H2 generation + reduced SMR load. ₹4 cr per MMTPA crude.

procs.rm: Vacuum gas oil (VGO) + heavy oil + slurry recycle
procs.out: Cracked products (gasoline, LPG, propylene, LCO, slurry), spent catalyst to regenerator
procs.q: Riser temperature (target ~520°C), conversion %, catalyst:oil ratio, coke on spent catalyst

d: Analyses FCC riser conditions (temperature, catalyst:oil ratio, feed quality), reactor effluent yields and catalyst circulation.
Models cracking kinetics and selectivity (gasoline + LPG + propylene yields).
Provides riser temperature + catalyst circulation + recycle advisory for maximum value-product yield.
p: FCC is THE conversion unit in refinery
uc.calc: Conversion uplift 1-2% × 30-40% of crude × value margin. ₹15 cr per MMTPA crude.

d: Analyses FCC catalyst inventory, activity, metals contamination (Ni, V from feed) and make-up rates.
Models catalyst aging and activity recovery from fresh additions.
Provides catalyst make-up advisory and supplier comparison.
p: Catalyst is significant FCC cost (₹15-30 cr/MMTPA crude)
uc.calc: Catalyst make-up reduction + supplier optimization. ₹6 cr per MMTPA crude.

uc.t: FCC Slurry & Heavy Oil Recycle Optimization
d: Analyses FCC slurry quality (BS&W, viscosity, ash) and heavy oil recycle versus conversion.
Models heavy oil cracking kinetics.
Provides slurry recycle + disposal advisory.
uc.calc: Heavy oil utilization + catalyst recovery. ₹3 cr per MMTPA crude.

f: Hot regen catalyst recycle to riser. Flue gas
procs.rm: Spent catalyst with coke deposit from reactor
procs.ut: Combustion air (large fans), fuel gas (torch oil if needed), power
procs.out: Regenerated hot catalyst back to riser, regenerator flue gas (CO, CO2, SOx, NOx, particulate)
procs.q: Regenerator temperature (~720°C), residual coke on regen catalyst, CO/CO2 ratio, NOx, particulate, SOx

d: Analyses regenerator temperature, oxygen profile, CO/CO2 ratio, NOx + SOx + particulate emissions.
Models combustion + emission formation.
Provides regenerator air + SOx/NOx reagent advisory for stable operation at compliance.
p: Regenerator upsets cause hours of disruption
uc.calc: Reagent reduction + compliance margin + stability. ₹5 cr per MMTPA crude.

procs.rm: FCC reactor effluent (cracked gas + vapor)
procs.out: Wet gas to gas plant, gasoline, LCO, slurry oil
procs.q: Product cut points, gasoline RON, LCO cetane, slurry quality

d: Analyses main fractionator cut points (gasoline, LCO, slurry), reflux + side draws and energy.
Models fractionation efficiency.
Provides cut-point advisory for maximum gasoline at minimum energy.
uc.calc: Cut-point uplift + energy savings. ₹3 cr per MMTPA crude.

procs.rm: VGO + heavy diesel + unconverted oil recycle
procs.out: Cracked products (jet, diesel, naphtha, LPG, gas), unconverted residue
procs.q: Conversion % (target 80-95%), product yields, sulfur compliance, catalyst activity

d: Analyses HCU reactor temperature profile (WABT), conversion, catalyst deactivation rate and product yields.
Models hydrocracking kinetics for catalyst life and conversion.
Provides reactor temperature + recycle ratio advisory for cycle extension.
p: HCU catalyst very expensive (₹50-100 cr per change)
uc.calc: Catalyst cycle extension 3-6 months × catalyst cost + downtime avoidance. ₹10 cr per MMTPA crude.

d: Analyses HCU product yields (jet, diesel, naphtha, LPG) versus operating conditions and market values.
Models product slate sensitivity to reactor severity.
Provides operating advisory for highest-margin product slate.
p: Product slate fixed by operator habit
uc.calc: Product margin uplift via slate optimization. ₹6 cr per MMTPA crude.

d: Analyses H2 consumption, H2 purity, H2 recycle ratio and chemical H2 consumption by reaction.
Models H2 economics and predicts optimal makeup.
Provides H2 management advisory.
p: Recycle gas purity degrades over cycle
uc.calc: H2 savings 5-10%. ₹4 cr per MMTPA crude.

procs.rm: Hydrocracker reactor effluent (cracked products + recycle)
procs.out: Jet/ATF, diesel, naphtha, LPG, fuel gas, recycle bottoms
procs.q: Product distillation, sulfur, cetane (diesel), smoke point (jet), product yields

d: Analyses fractionation tower energy consumption and product cuts.
Models energy vs separation tradeoff.
Provides reboiler + reflux advisory.
uc.calc: Tower energy savings 5-10%. ₹3 cr per MMTPA crude.

f: Coke drum (24hr cycle: filling, switching, steamout, cooling, decoking, warming)
procs.rm: Hot feed from coker heater (~500°C)
procs.out: Coker gas oil + naphtha + gas (to fractionator) + coke (in drum, drained after cycle)
procs.q: Drum cycle time, coke quality (S, V, Ni content), drum temperature profile, fluid coke vs needle coke

d: Analyses drum cycle time (filling, switching, steam out, cooling, decoking, warming) and coke production.
Models drum cycle dynamics and predicts optimal cycle time.
Provides cycle advisory for maximum throughput at safe coke quality.
uc.calc: Cycle compression + throughput uplift. ₹4 cr per MMTPA crude.

d: Analyses coker yields (coke, naphtha, gas oil) versus operating conditions.
Models coker yield economics.
Provides operating advisory for maximum liquid yield.
p: Liquid yield more valuable than coke
uc.calc: Liquid yield uplift × value differential. ₹3 cr per MMTPA crude.

f: Outlet to coke drums. Critical: prevent coking inside coils!
procs.rm: Vacuum residue (short residue from VDU)
procs.out: Heated coker feed to coke drums
procs.q: Coil outlet temperature (~500°C), velocity, heat flux, coking rate, coil pressure drop

uc.t: Coker Heater Coil Life & Coking Prevention
d: Analyses coker heater coil pressure drop, tube skin temperatures, velocity and downstream drum performance.
Predicts in-tube coking events and heater coil end of life.
Provides heater operation + cleaning advisory.
p: Coker heater coking is most dreaded refinery event (catastrophic failure mode)
Heater coil replacement = weeks of downtime + ₹50+ cr
uc.calc: Catastrophic event prevention + heater life extension. ₹5 cr per MMTPA crude.

procs.rm: Natural gas (feedstock + fuel), steam, makeup water
procs.out: Hydrogen (~99.9% purity) to hydrotreaters + HCU + cracker
procs.q: H2 purity, H2 yield (mol H2/mol CH4), specific energy (GCal/kNm³ H2), CO/CO2 slip

d: Analyses SMR operation (NG feed + fuel, steam-to-carbon ratio, reformer temperatures, PSA recovery).
Models reforming + shift + PSA economics.
Provides SMR operating advisory for minimum NG consumption per Nm³ H2.
uc.calc: NG savings 3-5% × H2 plant fuel + improved PSA recovery. ₹5 cr per MMTPA crude.

procs.rm: Acid gas (H2S) from amine regeneration
procs.ut: Combustion air (controlled), power, steam (sulfur tail gas line)
procs.out: Elemental sulfur (Claus process), tail gas (CO2, SO2, N2, residual H2S)
procs.q: Sulfur recovery efficiency % (target >99.5% with TGT), Claus conversion, tail gas SO2

d: Analyses SRU operation (acid gas feed rate, reaction furnace temperature, Claus reactor conversion, condenser performance).
Models Claus conversion kinetics.
Provides SRU operating advisory for >99% sulfur recovery.
uc.calc: Compliance margin + sulfur recovery. ₹3 cr per MMTPA crude.

procs.rm: SRU tail gas (SO2, residual H2S, sulfur)
procs.out: Recovered H2S to SRU feed (closed loop), clean tail gas to incinerator/stack
procs.q: Tail gas SO2 level, overall sulfur recovery %, amine performance, incinerator temperature

d: Analyses tail gas treating unit (amine performance, H2 hydrogenation, emissions).
Models tail gas chemistry.
Provides operating advisory for compliance at minimum reagent use.
uc.calc: Reagent savings + compliance. ₹2 cr per MMTPA crude.

f: Radiant coils (cracking, ~850°C, very short residence time)
procs.rm: Naphtha (or LPG, ethane) feedstock + dilution steam
procs.ut: Fuel (refinery fuel gas), combustion air, power
procs.out: Cracked gas (ethylene, propylene, butadiene, pygas, methane, hydrogen) to quench + cold box
procs.q: Conversion % (90-95%), C2/C3 ratio, P/E ratio, severity index, run length (days between decokes), tube skin temperatures

d: Analyses cracker furnace conditions (coil outlet temperature, residence time, steam dilution, feed rate) across all parallel furnaces.
Models cracking kinetics + coking dynamics in radiant coils.
Provides per-furnace severity advisory + decoke timing prediction for maximum ethylene + propylene yield at managed coking.
p: Furnace coking is THE central operational challenge in cracker
uc.calc: Ethylene yield uplift 0.5-1% × 1 MMTPA ethylene × ₹70,000/t margin = ₹35-70 cr potential. Conservative ₹30 cr per MMTPA ethylene.

d: Analyses thermal imaging of tubes, tube skin temperatures and creep history.
Predicts tube remaining life and recommends replacement scheduling.
p: Cracker tubes expensive (₹10-50 lakh each, dozens per furnace)
uc.calc: Tube life extension + reduced unplanned failures. ₹8 cr per MMTPA ethylene.

d: Analyses cracker furnace heat integration (TLE, dilution steam generation, fuel gas optimization).
Models heat balance and integration opportunities.
Provides heat integration advisory.
uc.calc: Heat integration + fuel savings. ₹4 cr per MMTPA ethylene.

procs.rm: Cracked gas from quench tower
procs.ut: Compressors (cracked gas), refrigeration (ethylene + propylene refrig), power
procs.out: Demethanizer overhead (CH4 + H2 to fuel), C2 stream to splitter, C3 stream, pygas
procs.q: Demethanizer recovery %, refrigeration energy, fractionation purity

d: Analyses cracked gas compression, cold box performance, refrigeration system (ethylene + propylene refrig) and energy consumption.
Models cryogenic separation efficiency and refrigeration load.
Provides cold box operation + refrigeration advisory.
p: Cracker cold box is huge energy consumer
uc.calc: Refrigeration + compressor savings 5-10% × very large base. ₹10 cr per MMTPA ethylene.

f: Polymer-grade ethylene + ethane recycle. C3 mixture
procs.rm: C2 stream (ethylene + ethane) and C3 stream (propylene + propane)
procs.out: Polymer-grade ethylene (>99.95%) and polymer-grade propylene (>99.5%), ethane recycle, propane
procs.q: Ethylene purity, propylene purity, recovery %, distillate yields

d: Analyses C2 splitter and C3 splitter performance (energy, purity, recovery).
Models splitter efficiency.
Provides reflux + reboiler advisory for target purity at minimum energy.
uc.calc: Splitter energy reduction 5-10%. ₹6 cr per MMTPA ethylene.

procs.rm: Polymer-grade ethylene + comonomer (1-butene, 1-hexene) + catalyst (Ziegler-Natta or metallocene)
procs.ut: Power (compressors, pumps), cooling water, H2 (chain transfer)
procs.out: Polyethylene powder/granules (LLDPE, HDPE) at target MFR and density
procs.q: MFR (Melt Flow Rate, g/10min), density, molecular weight distribution, comonomer incorporation, color/clarity

d: Analyses reactor temperature, pressure, comonomer dosing, H2 dosing, catalyst feed and resulting polymer properties.
Models polymerization kinetics and predicts MFR + density.
Provides reactor setpoint advisory for grade compliance.
uc.calc: Grade compliance + throughput + off-spec reduction. ₹8 cr per MMTPA polymer.

procs.rm: Polymer-grade propylene + comonomer (ethylene for impact copolymers) + catalyst (Ziegler-Natta)
procs.out: Polypropylene granules (homopolymer, random copolymer, impact copolymer)
procs.q: MFR, isotacticity, modulus, impact resistance, color

d: Analyses PP reactor (gas phase) conditions, catalyst feed, comonomer and quality.
Models PP polymerization and predicts grade transitions.
Provides operation and transition advisory.
p: PP grade complexity (homo, random, impact copolymer)
uc.calc: Transition optimization + off-spec reduction. ₹6 cr per MMTPA polymer.

procs.rm: Polymer granules from reactor
procs.out: Polymer pellets in bags (25kg) or bulk dispatch
procs.q: Pellet uniformity, additive distribution, color, pellet defects (gel, contamination)

d: Analyses online camera feeds at pelletizer outlet for pellet quality.
Detects black specks, contamination, deformed pellets, gel particles, color shifts.
Provides quality scoring and root cause analysis.
uc.calc: Defect reduction + customer claim prevention. ₹4 cr per MMTPA polymer.

uc.t: Polymer Production Planning & Grade Mix Optimization
d: Analyses order book, grade demand, reactor capacity, downstream extrusion + packaging.
Models grade-mix economics.
Provides scheduling advisory.
uc.calc: Schedule + transition optimization. ₹3 cr per MMTPA polymer.

procs.rm: Component streams (reformate, alkylate, FCC gasoline, HCU naphtha, blendstocks)
procs.ut: Power (pumps), online analyzers, blending control system
procs.out: Final products (MS Petrol BS-VI, HSD BS-VI, ATF, etc.) to product tankage
procs.q: RON/MON (gasoline), cetane (diesel), sulfur, oxygenate content, RVP, distillation

d: Analyses component streams (octane, sulfur, RVP, distillation), online analyzer data and blend recipe.
Models blend properties and predicts product spec compliance.
Provides real-time recipe advisory for spec compliance at minimum giveaway.
p: Quality giveaway is real cost (operating above spec = ₹2-5/L lost)
uc.calc: Giveaway reduction × product volume × value differential. ₹6 cr per MMTPA crude.

f: Destination tank/loading. Each transfer logged with quantity + quality.
procs.rm: Various products + intermediates being moved between tanks
procs.out: Product transfers between tanks, dispatch loading
procs.q: Cross-contamination prevention, line displacement losses, inventory accuracy, transfer time

d: Analyses tank-to-tank product movements, line displacement losses and cross-contamination risks.
Detects abnormal movements and contamination events.
Provides movement optimization advisory.
uc.calc: Contamination + line loss reduction. ₹3 cr per MMTPA crude.

d: Analyses loading rates, dispatch quality, customer-specific requirements and dispatch documentation.
Provides loading optimization and quality assurance.
uc.calc: Throughput + quality + demurrage. ₹2 cr per MMTPA crude.

procs.rm: Grid power + captive power + steam-driven turbines
procs.out: Distributed power to refinery (compressors largest), petchem and utilities
procs.q: Specific power (kWh/t crude), peak demand, power factor, reliability (uptime)

d: Analyses plant-wide power demand (compressors largest), captive generation and grid integration.
Models demand patterns and predicts peak loads.
Provides power management advisory.
uc.calc: Peak demand + power factor + tariff. ₹5 cr per MMTPA crude.

procs.rm: BFW (boiler feed water), fuel gas (steam boilers), exhaust steam from turbines
procs.out: Multiple steam levels (VHP/HP/MP/LP) for process heating, reboilers, stripping, atomization, ejectors
procs.q: Steam header pressures, flow distribution, condensate recovery%, venting losses, steam quality

d: Analyses inlet/outlet temperature signatures from wireless battery-powered sensors at each trap (~5,000-10,000 traps in large refinery).
Detects failed-open, failed-closed and failed-cold conditions.
Provides location-tagged alerts for proactive replacement.
p: Refineries have largest steam trap populations (5,000-15,000)
uc.calc: Trap failure rate 15% × ~7,000 traps × ₹3 lakh/yr × 50% capture. ₹4 cr per MMTPA crude.

procs.rm: Makeup water (often poor quality), cooling tower chemicals
procs.ut: Power (CW pumps, cooling tower fans), chemicals (corrosion + scale + biocide)
procs.out: Cooling water at supply temperature (~35°C) to process exchangers; warmed return water (~45°C)
procs.q: Supply temperature, fouling factor in exchangers, water quality (conductivity, hardness), blowdown

d: Analyses cooling water supply temperature, return temperatures, individual exchanger fouling and pump operation.
Models CW system performance and predicts fouling.
Provides CT chemistry + pump operation advisory.
p: Cooling water key to all units
uc.calc: Pump energy + fouling + makeup. ₹3 cr per MMTPA crude.

f: Combustion. Flare gas recovery system tries to compress + return to fuel gas before flaring.
procs.rm: Off-spec gas, relief vents, blowdown from process units
procs.out: Combusted hydrocarbons (CO2 + H2O), some unrecovered flaring loss
procs.q: Flare gas flow rate, smokeless operation, pilot reliability, methane recovery from flare gas

uc.t: Flare Gas Recovery & Methane Emission Reduction
d: Analyses flare gas flow (continuous + intermittent), composition and recovery system performance.
Detects sources of flaring and quantifies methane emissions.
Provides flare reduction advisory and recovery optimization.
uc.calc: Flare gas recovery + methane emission credits. ₹4 cr per MMTPA crude.

procs.rm: Oily water (process + tank drainage), spent caustic, sour water, stormwater, sanitary
procs.ut: Power (aerators, pumps), chemicals (coagulant, polymer), biological cultures
procs.out: Treated effluent (within PCB norms), oil recovery, treated water for reuse where possible
procs.q: Outlet COD, BOD, oil & grease, phenol, sulphide, pH, treated water reuse %

d: Analyses ETP performance (COD, BOD, oil, sulphide) and chemical dosing.
Models treatment kinetics and predicts compliance.
Provides operating advisory for compliance + water reuse maximization.
uc.calc: Chemical + water reuse + compliance. ₹2 cr per MMTPA crude.

procs.rm: OT data (DCS, PLC, RTU), MES, ERP, LIMS, online analyzers, IoT sensor streams
procs.ut: Edge gateways, network infrastructure, cloud compute, integration with existing PI/Aspen/Honeywell
procs.out: Unified data layer enabling AI Operations Layer on top of existing APC/historian/MES
procs.q: Tag coverage %, data quality, latency, uptime, integration completeness with existing tools

uc.vt: Enabler for all other use cases
d: Foundational data layer: integration with existing DCS/PI historian/Aspen/Honeywell APC + LIMS + ERP.
AI Operations Layer above existing tools — NOT replacement of APC/RTO. Complements and extends.
Provides unified data + edge connectivity + AI app deployment platform.
p: Refinery data already in PI + Aspen + Honeywell tools
uc.calc: Enabler — value realized through downstream use cases.

procs.rm: Lab samples (crude, intermediate, products at every unit), online analyzers, customer specs
procs.ut: Lab instruments (GC, NMR, sulfur, distillation, octane, density), LIMS
procs.out: Multi-stream quality intelligence, COA, traceability, product compliance (BS-VI etc.)
procs.q: Spec compliance %, lab TAT (often 1-6 hr), online analyzer reliability, COA accuracy

d: Integrates lab quality data (crude, every intermediate, every product) with online analyzers and process data.
Provides multi-stream quality intelligence, COA automation, BS-VI compliance tracking and customer audit prep.
Provides early warning on quality drift + faster lab-to-process feedback.
p: Refinery LIMS has hundreds of routine tests
uc.calc: Quality drift reduction + audit prep + COA automation. ₹4 cr per MMTPA crude.

procs.rm: Sensor data (vibration, temp, oil quality, motor current, process), maintenance history, spare parts
procs.ut: Edge processing, CBM platform, CMMS, MRO inventory system
procs.out: Failure predictions, work orders, reliability KPIs, optimized spares
procs.q: Equipment availability %, MTBF on critical assets (compressors, turbines, fired heaters), unplanned downtime hours

uc.t: CBM for Critical Rotating Equipment (Compressors, Turbines)
d: Analyses vibration, temperature, motor signature, oil quality from critical rotating equipment: cracked gas compressors, ethylene/propylene refrig compressors, hydrogen makeup compressors, steam turbines, large pumps.
Predicts bearing failures, seal degradation, balance issues, alignment problems.
Provides equipment-tagged alerts and remaining-useful-life estimates.
p: Cracked gas compressor failure = cracker shutdown (₹5-10 cr/day)
Hydrogen compressor failure = hydrotreater stops (BS-VI risk)
Critical equipment is biggest reliability risk
uc.calc: Unplanned downtime reduction × refinery margin × hours saved. ₹15 cr per MMTPA crude.

d: Workflow management for maintenance work orders, planned/unplanned tracking, asset history.
Integrates CBM alerts into work order generation and tracks closure.
Provides asset-level reliability metrics + turnaround (T&I) planning support.
p: Maintenance work tracked in legacy systems
Work orders don't close on time
uc.calc: Work order closure + T&I planning + maintenance cost transparency. ₹5 cr per MMTPA crude.

d: Analyses refinery spare parts inventory (large + complex), lead times, criticality and consumption patterns.
Models optimal stocking for critical spares (compressor seals, turbine blades, heater tubes, catalyst).
Provides inventory optimization advisory.
uc.calc: Inventory reduction 15-20% + emergency procurement savings. ₹4 cr per MMTPA crude.

procs.rm: CCTV feeds, fixed gas detectors (H2S, LEL, NH3, CO), flame detectors, thermal imaging
procs.ut: CV platform, edge inference, integration with F&G system, alert infrastructure
procs.out: Real-time safety alerts (gas plumes, PPE, hot work, restricted zones), MAH compliance, incident analytics
